description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
